Vajjiputtattheragāthā Vajjiputta (2nd)

“Rukkhamūlagahanaṁ pasakkiya, You’ve left for the jungle, the root of a tree, Nibbānaṁ hadayasmiṁ opiya; having laid extinguishment in your heart. Jhāya gotama mā ca pamādo, Meditate, Gotama, don’t be negligent! Kiṁ te biḷibiḷikā karissatī”ti. What use is this hullabaloo to you?

… Vajjiputto thero ….
